summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing the internal rules of its Compliance and Audit Committee. The document defines the committee's advisory role to the board, its operational autonomy, budget, and reporting lines, along with the duties of the Compliance and Conformity Officer. No transaction terms, stakeholder actions, or corporate-event catalysts are present. This is a routine governance disclosure with no special-situation element. As a non-US filing (Brazilian issuer), it is equivalent to a home-country governance update. There is no event to watch or arbitrage angle.
